title: 缺少云存档等基础功能
description: 游戏缺少Steam云存档、成就等基础功能，玩家需手动转移存档，且信息获取不便。
evidence: bring in steam cloud saves so we can switch computers without having to manually move our files over
Kinda annoyed, that i need to transfer saves each time from place to place (work, home)
